purpose: ok this is messy but i need help fast. i own a specialty pool + outdoor living company and one of these instagram “growth guys” says he can bring us higher-end remodel clients for pools, turf, pergolas, kitchens, lighting, patios etc. we’ve been talking by phone and dm only. i need an agreement asap because if this works it could be huge but i don’t want chaos. he wants $6,500 monthly plus 12% on deals he directly sources that actually close, but i only want commission after customer deposit clears and if customer cancels in first 30 days i want that clawed back. he says he may hire videographers and run ads. i need clear approval rights because i don’t want fake promises, bad before/after edits, misleading financing claims, or cheesy testimonials that get us in trouble. anything with ftc rules or ad compliance needs covered. all leads, crm data, ad accounts, pixels, landing pages, text campaigns, call recordings, photos we pay for, and customer info should stay ours. if he leaves he can’t take the pipeline. maybe exclusivity for phoenix metro only if he sends at least 8 qualified leads a month for 3 straight months. also need nda/confidentiality because margins/pricing/vendors matter. need noncircumvent so he doesn’t go around us to subs or clients. need non solicit so he doesn’t poach our salespeople. want 12 month term with auto renew unless 30 day notice. immediate termination for fraud, brand damage, criminal stuff, or repeated bad leads. reimbursement only if preapproved in writing. arbitration maybe, arizona or delaware maybe whichever is stronger. need clean review edits then e-signatures because i may send to partner first. make this serious not generic.
title: Confidentiality Agreement
